plan.name: Claim only successful verification evidence
plan.summary: This first slice of #229 corrects legacy assurance claims: a successful proof naming at least one function establishes proved, successful agreement or conformance establishes tested against the model, and otherwise the code is unchecked, without changing whether the gate passes. The gate records that assurance in JSON, while Markdown receipts and dashboard summaries derive claims from evidence even in older reports with stale labels; at every size requires successful nonempty proof and the larger check, and tested in every state requires successful exhaustive conformance with positive matching state counts and no failed attempt check. Keep successful legacy Go, Python and TypeScript receipts and fingerprints unchanged, retain their unverified-function lists, and show unchecked dashboard cards without implying successful coverage. Update SPEC.md and README.md to describe this correction and its limits, citing the existing evidence and receipt decisions D-0013, D-0024, D-0031, D-0070, D-0152 and D-0122 where applicable; the merger must record the new assurance policy because this plumbing build cannot write decisions/. The merger opens follow-up issues until #224 is fixed to attribute separate proof, bounded or sampled conformance, runtime checks and trusted assumptions to components, fix partial-proof claims about unchecked neighbors, bind source and contract identities into fingerprints, add component receipts and dashboard views, discover Python and TypeScript components, and connect execution before removing the explicit-components refusal; ratified statements and the model-only path remain unchanged.

tests.name: TestReportClaimsRequireSuccessfulEvidence
tests.says: Claims come from successful proof, agreement or conformance results, never stale assurance labels, source discovery, a successful build alone, or failed checks; successful evidence survives unrelated gate failures.

tests.name: TestEverySizeRequiresANonemptySuccessfulProof
tests.says: At every size requires a successful proof naming functions and a successful larger check; a missing, failed or empty proof cannot establish it.

tests.name: TestGateRecordsOnlyAssuranceEstablishedByToolResults
tests.says: The real gate records tested or unchecked, never proved, when Gobra fails or omits its result, preserves the mixed package's unverified neighbor, keeps gate outcomes unchanged, and fingerprints the final JSON assurance deterministically.

tests.name: TestReceiptsUseSuccessfulEvidenceAndPreserveLegacyOutput
tests.says: Markdown rejects unsupported proof and every-size claims while successful legacy Go, Python and TypeScript receipts, including their unverified-function lists and fingerprints, remain unchanged.

tests.name: TestDashboardAssuranceRequiresSuccessfulEvidence
tests.says: Dashboard JSON derives assurance and proved counts from successful results, calls missing evidence unchecked, and requires successful exhaustive conformance with positive matching counts and no failed attempt check for tested in every state.
